title: Scandinavian Nordic Board
seo_title: Scandinavian Charcuterie Board for 6–10: Gravlax & Rye
description: A Scandinavian charcuterie board for 6–10: Jarlsberg, dill Havarti, gravlax, smoked herring, Swedish meatballs, lingonberry jam, pickled beets and rye crispbread.
hook: Gravlax, dill and rye: the flavors of the North, with salt, acid, fat and smoke all in plain sight.
why: Nordic food balances salt, acid, fat and smoke, and this board puts all four out: salt-and-dill-cured gravlax, smoked herring, pickled beets and crème fraîche. Mild, nutty Jarlsberg and dill Havarti tie the cheese to the herbs.
Swedish meatballs with lingonberry jam are the familiar bite that makes it approachable, and sweet-hot gravlax mustard sauce is what gravlax is made for. Dark rye and crispbread carry everything.

timeline.what: Arrange the gravlax; make the mustard sauce.
Slice the rye bread; fill the small bowls.
Place the cheeses; set out the sauces and capers.
Lay the gravlax; add the dill and cucumber.

faq.a: Salmon cured in salt, sugar and dill. It's not smoked, so it tastes cleaner and more herbal than smoked salmon.

faq.q: What goes on a Scandinavian board?
faq.a: Gravlax, smoked or pickled herring, Swedish meatballs, Jarlsberg, Havarti, lingonberry jam, pickled beets, cucumber, radishes, dill, mustard sauce, crème fraîche and rye crispbread.
Cured, uncooked fish like gravlax is generally advised against during pregnancy. Offer the meatballs and cheeses instead.
